name: Merari (Levi's son)
title: Ancestor of the Merarites
summary: Merari was the youngest of Levi's three sons and became the ancestor of the Merarites, one of the three main groups of Levites. His descendants were responsible for carrying and caring for the structural elements of the tabernacle during the wilderness journey.

keyEvents.title: Born as Levi's son
keyEvents.description: Merari was born the youngest of Levi's three sons, along with his brothers Gershon and Kohath.

keyEvents.title: Traveled to Egypt
keyEvents.description: Merari was among Jacob's family who went down to Egypt during the famine, and he is mentioned in the list of Jacob's descendants.

keyEvents.title: Ancestor of the Merarites
keyEvents.description: Merari's sons Mahli and Mushi became the ancestors of the Merarite clans, who were given specific duties in the tabernacle service.

keyEvents.title: The Service of the Merarites at the Tabernacle
keyEvents.description: Merari's descendants were responsible for the tabernacle's boards, bars, pillars, bases, and all the accessories belonging to these parts.
